phases.name: Phase 1 - Foundation
phases.focus: Stability, light load comprehension, and movement re-education with emphasis on knee-friendly mechanics.

phases.name: Phase 2 - Build & Control
phases.focus: Progressive loading with controlled tempo to build strength while protecting the knee.

phases.name: Phase 3 - Strength Transfer
phases.focus: Increase absolute load and introduce ski-specific patterns within safe ranges.

non_negotiables: No deep knee flexion under load
Surgeon clearance required; all exercises must be knee-friendly and pain-free
Full gym access with barbells, dumbbells, machines; avoid impact-based movements
Progression must use submaximal loads with attention to form and pain signals
Warm-up included prior to each session with knee-friendly mobility and activation
Return-to-sport plan aligned with skiing goals and not to exceed pain-free ROM

stage2.text:
PLAN "12-Week Knee-Friendly Strength & Ski Return"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public
GOALS
  GOAL primary strength and skiing return:
    name "12-week progressive, knee-friendly strength program"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Upper training 60m "Knee-friendly upper strength and stability":
        warmup:
          leg_cradle_stability 3m
          scapular_retraction 2m
          band_external_rotation 2m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90s
          overhead_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
          chest_stretch 2m
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Lower (safe) training 50m "Knee-friendly lower strength, controlled tempo":
        warmup:
          hip_openers 3m
          glute_bridge 2m
          leg_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          hip_hinge_restrict 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          leg_extension (light) 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60s
          seated_leg_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
          calves_stretch 2m
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Push/Pull training 40m "Push/Pull with knee-friendly loads":
        warmup:
          band_pull_aparts 2m
          face_pull 2m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          cable_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90s
          dumbbell_fly 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90s
          seated_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          thoracic_rotation 2m
          lat_stretch 2m
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Accessory / Mobility 40m "Mobility and small patterns":
        warmup:
          hip_activations 3m
        main straight_sets:
          hanging_leg_raise (supported) 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60s
          pallof_press 3x12 sec hold 5 rest 60s
          farmer_walk 3x20m rpe 5 rest 60s
          pallof_press 3x12 sec hold 5 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
          spinal_twist 2m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Upper training 60m "Progression with light loads":
        warmup:
          band_external_rotation 2m
          scapular_retraction 2m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          arnold_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          cable_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90s
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
          chest_stretch 2m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Lower (safe) training 50m "Tempo control and stability":
        warmup:
          glute_bridge 2m
          ankle mobility 2m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90s
          Romanian_deadlift 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60s
          hip_abduction 3x12 each side rpe 6 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          calf_stretch 2m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Push/Pull training 40m "Balanced upper push/pull":
        warmup:
          scapular_retraction 2m
          band_external_rotation 2m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          barbell_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60s
          cable_fly 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
          adductions_stretch 2m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Accessory / Mobility 40m "Mobility and light pattern practice":
        warmup:
          hip_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          planks 3x30s rpe 4 rest 60s
          side_plank 3x20s each side rpe 4 rest 60s
          glute_bridge march 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60s
          thoracic_rotation 3x6 each side
        cooldown:
          pigeon_pose 2m
          cat_cow 2m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Upper training 60m "Continue progression, add slight volume":
        warmup:
          band_pull_aparts 2m
          face_pull 2m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6 rpe 6 rest 90s
          dumbbell_row 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          overhead_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
          chest_stretch 2m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Lower (safe) training 50m "Continue knee-friendly loading":
        warmup:
          leg_mobility_flow 3m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          hip_hinge_restrict 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          leg_extension (light) 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60s
          standing_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 5 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Push/Pull training 40m "Balanced upper push/pull with form focus":
        warmup:
          band_external_rotation 2m
          scapular_retraction 2m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x6 rpe 6 rest 90s
          cable_row 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          dumbbell_fly 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60s
          seated_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          thoracic_rotation 2m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Accessory / Mobility 40m "Stability and soft tissue work":
        warmup:
          hip_activations 3m
        main straight_sets:
          hanging_leg_raise (supported) 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60s
          pallof_press 3x12 sec hold 5 rest 60s
          farmer_walk 3x24m rpe 5 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Upper training 60m "Phase 1 deload: adapt and reinforce form":
        warmup:
          band_external_rotation 2m
          scapular_retraction 2m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          barbell_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          overhead_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Lower (safe) training 50m "Foundation stability + light loading":
        warmup:
          glute_bridge 2m
          leg_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          Romanian_deadlift 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60s
          standing_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 5 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Push/Pull training 40m "Stability to strength transition":
        warmup:
          band_pull_aparts 2m
          face_pull 2m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          cable_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90s
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60s
          cable_fly 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Accessory / Mobility 40m "Mobility and soft tissue care":
        warmup:
          hip_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          planks 3x30s rpe 4 rest 60s
          side_plank 3x20s each side rpe 4 rest 60s
          pallof_press 3x12 sec hold 5 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          pigeon_pose 2m
  PHASE "Phase 2 - Build & Control" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Upper training 60m "Load progression with tempo control":
        warmup:
          band_external_rotation 2m
          scapular_retraction 2m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6 rpe 6 rest 90s
          dumbbell_row 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          push_ups (modified) 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60s
          lat_pulldown 4x10 rpe 6 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Lower (safe) training 50m "Controlled loading for knee":
        warmup:
          hip_opens 2m
          glute_bridge 2m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          Romanian_deadlift 4x6 rpe 6 rest 90s
          leg_extension light 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60s
          standing_calf_raise 4x15 rpe 5 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Push/Pull training 40m "Push/pull balance with tempo":
        warmup:
          band_pull_aparts 2m
          face_pull 2m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x6 rpe 6 rest 90s
          barbell_row 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          shoulder_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          cable_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          thoracic_rotation 2m
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Accessory / Mobility 40m "Ski pattern prep mobility":
        warmup:
          hip_activations 3m
        main straight_sets:
          hanging_leg_raise (supported) 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60s
          pallof_press 3x12 sec hold 5 rest 60s
          farmer_walk 3x24m rpe 5 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Upper training 60m "Increase load tolerance":
        warmup:
          band_external_rotation 2m
          scapular_retraction 2m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5 rpe 7 rest 90s
          dumbbell_row 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90s
          overhead_press 3x6 rpe 7 rest 90s
          lat_pulldown 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Lower (safe) training 50m "Safe progression":
        warmup:
          glute_bridge 2m
          leg_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          Romanian_deadlift 4x6 rpe 6 rest 90s
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60s
          standing_calf_raise 4x15 rpe 5 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Push/Pull training 40m "Balanced load in upper":
        warmup:
          band_pull_aparts 2m
          face_pull 2m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x6 rpe 6 rest 90s
          cable_row 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60s
          cable_fly 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Accessory / Mobility 40m "Mobility and prep for ski patterns":
        warmup:
          hip_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          planks 3x45s rpe 4 rest 60s
          side_plank 3x25s each side rpe 4 rest 60s
          pallof_press 3x12 sec hold 5 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          pigeon_pose 2m
  PHASE "Phase 3 - Strength Transfer" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Upper training 60m "Ski-specific strength patterns":
        warmup:
          band_external_rotation 2m
          scapular_retraction 2m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5 rpe 7 rest 90s
          one_arm_row 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90s
          push_press (light) 3x6 rpe 7 rest 90s
          lat_pulldown 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Lower (safe) training 50m "Controlled ski-range loading":
        warmup:
          hip_openers 2m
          glute_bridge 2m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90s
          Romanian_deadlift 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90s
          leg_extension light 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60s
          standing_calf_raise 4x12 rpe 5 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Push/Pull training 40m "Functional upper patterns":
        warmup:
          band_pull_aparts 2m
          face_pull 2m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90s
          barbell_row 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90s
          overhead_press 3x6 rpe 7 rest 90s
          cable_pulldown 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          thoracic_rotation 2m
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Accessory / Mobility 40m "Final ski pattern prep":
        warmup:
          hip_activations 3m
        main straight_sets:
          planks 3x60s rpe 4 rest 60s
          pallof_press 3x12 sec hold 5 rest 60s
          farmer_walk 3x28m rpe 5 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Upper training 60m "Peak strength maintenance":
        warmup:
          band_external_rotation 2m
          scapular_retraction 2m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5 rpe 7 rest 90s
          dumbbell_row 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90s
          push_ups (modified) 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60s
          lat_pulldown 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Lower (safe) training 50m "Return-to-sport knee-friendly loads":
        warmup:
          leg_mobility_flow 3m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90s
          deadlift from rack 4x5 rpe 7 rest 90s
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60s
          standing_calf_raise 4x12 rpe 5 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Push/Pull training 40m " ski-sport transfer pattern":
        warmup:
          band_pull_aparts 2m
          face_pull 2m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90s
          barbell_row 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90s
          shoulder_press 3x6 rpe 7 rest 90s
          cable_pulldown 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          thoracic_rotation 2m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Accessory / Mobility 40m "Final mobility tune-up":
        warmup:
          hip_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          hollow_hold 3x30s rpe 4 rest 60s
          pallof_press 3x12 sec hold 5 rest 60s
          farmer_walk 3x28m rpe 5 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          pigeon_pose 2m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Upper training 60m "Unload and consolidate gains":
        warmup:
          band_external_rotation 2m
          scapular_retraction 2m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          one_arm_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          push_press (light) 3x6 rpe 6 rest 90s
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Lower (safe) training 50m "Knee-friendly return to ski ROM":
        warmup:
          hip_openers 2m
          glute_bridge 2m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          Romanian_deadlift 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          leg_extension light 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60s
          standing_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 5 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Push/Pull training 40m "Maintenance and symmetry":
        warmup:
          band_pull_aparts 2m
          face_pull 2m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          cable_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90s
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60s
          cable_fly 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Accessory / Mobility 40m "Pre-ski readiness":
        warmup:
          hip_activations 3m
        main straight_sets:
          planks 3x45s rpe 4 rest 60s
          pallof_press 3x12 sec hold 5 rest 60s
          farmer_walk 3x28m rpe 5 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Upper training 60m "Taper to skiing readiness":
        warmup:
          band_external_rotation 2m
          scapular_retraction 2m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x6 rpe 6 rest 90s
          dumbbell_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          overhead_press 3x6 rpe 6 rest 90s
          lat_pulldown 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Lower (safe) training 50m "Tapered leg work, no deep flexion under load":
        warmup:
          leg_mobility_flow 3m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x6 rpe 6 rest 90s
          Romanian_deadlift 3x6 rpe 6 rest 90s
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60s
          standing_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 5 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Push/Pull training 40m "Ski return readiness - light pattern recap":
        warmup:
          band_pull_aparts 2m
          face_pull 2m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          barbell_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60s
          cable_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          thoracic_rotation 2m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Accessory / Mobility 40m "Final mobility and readiness check":
        warmup:
          hip_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          hollow_hold 3x30s rpe 4 rest 60s
          pallof_press 3x12 sec hold 5 rest 60s
          farmer_walk 3x28m rpe 5 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          pigeon_pose 2m

END PLAN
